newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids higher.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were solidly higher Monday in response to slow farmer sales, U.S. merchandisers said.
"We've got excellent growing conditions out here but the farmer is still holding tight," said one Montana dealer. "There's nothing moving."
Concerns aboout too-dry weather in north and southwestern North Dakota and eastern Montana lingered in the market and helped to keep farmer sales very slow, dealers said.
Parts of Minnesota are also said to need rain.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture reported Monday that 69 percent of the spring wheat crop was in good or excellent condition, against 72 percent a year ago.
